task_description: Three agents need to collaborate to set up a community workshop event. The tasks involve finding a venue, arranging for speakers, and coordinating a marketing campaign. Each agent has specific responsibilities, and they need to ensure all tasks are completed on time without any resource conflicts.
expected_outcome: The agents should successfully allocate tasks, manage resources without conflicts, and ensure all dependencies are communicated effectively to execute the plan seamlessly.

agents.description: Agent 1 is responsible for overall coordination and ensures that tasks are broken down and resources are allocated efficiently.
Agent 2 handles finding and securing a venue for the event, ensuring it meets all requirements.
Agent 3 is responsible for the marketing campaign, ensuring that the event reaches the target audience.
